## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle alternative recension of Bodhiruci's *Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā* translation. Signature: 「元魏留支三藏奉詔譯」 (with the abbreviated form 留支 for 流支). The text is a textually slightly different state of the same Bodhiruci translation as [T236a](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0024). For the *Vajracchedikā* tradition broadly, see [T235](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0023).

**Abstract**

T236b is the parallel-recension companion of T236a in the Sòng / Yuán canonical traditions; the same translation transmitted in slightly different textual state. Modern scholarship treats the two as a single Bodhiruci translation in different manuscript-traditions; the two-fold Taishō encoding preserves both states.
